keyLimits.en: 1 user, 2 accountant seats, send 2 invoices/month free (unlimited with Payments), 1 connected bank account, automated bookkeeping
3 users, 2 accountant seats, enhanced reports, employee time tracking
5 users, 2 accountant seats, budget planning, project profitability, inventory management, up to 40 classes/locations
25 users, 3 accountant seats, unlimited classes/locations/custom KPIs, batch invoices and expenses, priority support

addOns.en: QuickBooks Payments (payment processing) unlocks unlimited invoicing on Simple Start.

cautions.en: Frequent launch promotion of 50% off for the first 3 months (e.g. Simple Start at $19/mo instead of $38/mo); the regular, non-promotional price is the one recorded here.

capabilities.en: Accounting, invoicing and expense tracking for freelancers, self-employed and small businesses, with profit & loss reporting.
Automated bookkeeping, bank connections, bill pay with free ACH, and payment acceptance built into invoices.
Higher tiers add inventory management, project profitability tracking, budget planning and construction-specific financials (Advanced).

limitations.en: No free plan; the entry paid tier (Simple Start) already limits to 1 user and 2 invoices/month without the Payments add-on.
Multi-user access, inventory and project tracking require moving up to Essentials or Plus, raising cost quickly for a growing team.

reason.en: Existing catalogue alternative already flagged for QuickBooks Online in the tool's current alternatives.
Existing catalogue alternative, simpler invoicing/accounting tool for independents.
Direct competitor with similar plan structure for freelancers and small businesses.
Comparable accounting and invoicing tool targeting freelancers and small teams.
